decisions.text: Separate V7 development branch; do not modify V6, main, or original wheeled app.
Report design and visualization is V7 main focus.
Preserve source data, reported evidence tier, uncertainty, G3=0 and protected field approvals.
Use same actual Android report generators for previews and tests; no lookalike templates.
No automatic adoption of 4x2/8-per-page infographic layout in field reports.
13 owner observations are binding V7 design requirements (G01-G13), recorded in design charter.
Arabic first and bilingual PDF, all text >=12 pt, tables with amber-yellow/black bold headers and black borders, real logo and header.
Context-aware exposure limits and GHS, physiometric gauges where valid, meaningful color states, 3D only with true evidence dimensions, transparent ChemCore decision charts.
The color family and report header/footer geometry are owner-approved by G15-G18; exact amber shade, official logo asset and per-report plot/layout prototypes still require design signoff.
Current owner mentions 76 ChemCore techniques while earlier goal was 80; perform repository count and executed-technique registry audit before displaying any counts in PDF.
G14: PDF generators must not add independent analytical eligibility gates; use engine decision/metric/reference states as authoritative and preserve output fidelity.
G15: all report content backgrounds pure white; four brand colors black/white/amber-orange/gray; chart-only supplementary colors must be clear and non-pale.
G16: document timestamp from original measurement event, never replace with PDF export time; true capture time range when report aggregates sessions.

G17: fixed black header with logo right, 15pt bold amber-orange bilingual title center, white measurement time left; narrow margins, 1.15 line spacing, zero paragraph spacing, cell padding 2mm LR 1mm TB.
G18: light-gray footer with left black bold 14pt Arabic page n/N and right two-color HazRob official wordmark.

Owner supplied official HazRob hexagonal targeting logo and explicitly approved placement at right side of every V7 black report header; use asset hazrob_official_report_mark.xml not old tracked robot icon.

User-proposed more efficient workflow adopted: review and approve R01-R06 report specs individually first, then implement all reports together using shared PDF components; test each exporter during integrated build.

For R02 missing physical values, use the literal ASCII hyphen '-' (U+002D) instead of Arabic 'غير متوفر', em dash or N/A, keeping separate engine-provided data-quality notes and original null values intact.

R02 design must include all 15 PhysicalCatalog indicators including ionizing radiation, UV, wind speed/direction, illuminance/flux, PM1/PM2.5/PM10, plus derived altitude and engine-delivered thermal analyses; no PDF-side gates.

Include full R02 physical report pages and dedicated particle analytics in same approved Field Session PDF for each actually selected G/F/P measurement family, preserving archived per-cycle provenance and optionally mixed A4 orientations.

Display all engine-produced 3D/4D analyses, temperature/humidity compensation, fingerprint/curve comparisons, research versus reportable ppm and executed technique provenance without PDF-side analytic gates.

Make ranked candidate results prominent with original candidate-specific GHS pictograms, SDS classification provenance, and exposure-limit references TWA/STEL/Ceiling etc, preserving each result's engine evidence status.
No arbitrary top-N report caps, source truncation or source gate duplication; maintain verified approved-cycle SHA and evidence integrity as independent storage guarantees.

Owner explicitly approves a four-equal-chart 2x2 gallery on A4 landscape: 141.5×79.5mm panels with 4mm gutters in 287mm content width, all AR/EN labels ≥12pt. This supersedes earlier recommendation of two large figures.

Owner approves a dedicated R03 3D/4D and T/RH compensation page: large empty multi-dimensional graph on top and two lower before/after and T/RH influence panels, with no sample curves or invented values.

Owner approves rich unlimited candidate table: candidate identity CAS/UID, evidence rank, candidate-specific official GHS toxicity/hazard pictograms, visually distinct presentation and miniature PPM-vs-authoritative-exposure-reference chart per candidate. During layout phase missing values are '-' and the chart is completely empty.

Owner approves R05 fruit PDF redesign: fixed RTL first column with actual fruit or mixture photograph for all 18 selectable food-family rows; only chosen family displays its later engine-derived results, other rows show literal '-', with all-family selection able to populate more than one; two A4 portrait pages, nine fruit rows per page, 12pt minimum, reserved empty chart regions; 54 fruit profiles, five mushroom profiles excluded. No gas ppm, food safety certification, Java source changes or invented sample readings.

Owner approves R06 complete beef-only research PDF design with three A4 portrait pages (not two): page1 specimen/7-MQ/four study classes, page2 three distinct sensor/reference/180s/class-similarity blank chart slots, mandatory page3 4x4 held-out study confusion matrix, source-only 36h timeline and model provenance/limitations. No values if missing ('-'), no invented plots. Food safety/TVC not claimed, gas GHS/OEL/PPM not imported. Code DOI metadata correction later, not now.

Owner explicitly authorizes increasing or reducing page counts on R01–R06 freely. Previous page counts (including R05 two and R06 three and R03 chart pages) are preview targets only, never hard caps or mandated indices. Preserve every owner-approved section/figure/reference, >=12pt fonts, no truncation, data absence '-', blank charts, and automatic true n/N pagination.
